entities.name: Marinus Adrianus Koekkoek II
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marinus Adrianus Koekkoek, known as The Younger was a Dutch animal painter, who specialized in birds. He is referred to as "the younger" to distinguish him from his great-uncle, the landscape painter, Marinus Adrianus Koekkoek, after whom he was named.
